value: We predicted that cognitive reappraisal would decrease the duration of activation in emotion-responsive regions such as the amygdala and insula and increase the duration of activation in emotion-regulatory cognitive control regions such as the MPFC and lateral PFC.

We also predicted that using an increase positive regulation strategy would lead to a smaller reduction in the height and or width of activation in arousal-related regions (e.g. amygdala, insula, ACC) than would using a decrease negative regulation strategy.
